messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — elevated 5xx rate observed at edge-proxy (us-west-2). Sampling shows spike starting ~14:03 UTC. Notifying on-call.
morgan (oncall): taking it. what are we seeing for customer impact?
casey (prod-support): multiple customers reporting failed requests in the dashboard, ~25-40 rps failing. chat sessions timing out. no billing anomalies yet.
nora (eng-api): grepping logs — repeated upstream 504s from runtime pool, correlation_id=cid-9f3a2b across many lines.
devin (eng-runtime): can you paste the raw lines you see?
nora (eng-api): ```
[14:04:12.451] WARN  proxy request failed status=504 upstream=runtime-03 cid=cid-9f3a2b route=/v1/generate latency=1203ms
[14:04:12.452] INFO  retry enqueued attempts=1 cid=cid-9f3a2b
[14:04:12.520] WARN  proxy request failed status=504 upstream=runtime-04 cid=cid-9f3a2b route=/v1/generate latency=1300ms
[14:04:13.002] WARN  proxy request failed status=504 upstream=runtime-02 cid=cid-4d1e9a route=/v1/chat latency=1402ms
```
ashley (sre): hmm, looks like retry amplification. gateway retries=2, upstream timeout appears to be 1s, but observed latencies >1.2s — retries overlap and amplify load.
devin (eng-runtime): quick check: was there any config churn? timeline shows a config rollout at 13:57.
morgan (oncall): @nora can you fetch the deploy metadata for that rollout id?
nora (eng-api): deploy fd8a3c7 rolled at 13:57 by infra-automation. Diff: proxy.timeout_ms changed from 1200 -> 1000 and upstream_retries kept at 2.
casey (prod-support): impact summary for ops: long prompts (>1k tokens) are the most affected, customer sessions drop mid-generation.
devin (eng-runtime): mitigation proposal: revert proxy.timeout_ms to 1500ms and disable automatic client retries for 10m to let upstream queues drain.
ashley (sre): I'll push a retry kill-switch in the gateway config as a canary to us-west-2a. will monitor 5xx rate.
morgan (oncall): do the canary, post correlation ids for test traffic so we can trace.
ashley (sre): canary patch applied 14:12, test requests: cid=test-0001 -> 200 OK, cid=test-0002 -> 200 OK.
nora (eng-api): after canary, observed 5xx rate in canary AZ dropped from ~18% -> ~2% within 3 minutes. global rate trending down.
morgan (oncall): good. keep incident open for RCA — collect related logs, map correlation ids, and build hypothesis list (config change + retry amplification + long tail latency).
casey (prod-support): notifying affected customers about ongoing mitigation and expected ETA for stable behavior.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated (severity from high -> medium). Follow-up: schedule RCA, attach timeline and correlated logs (cid-9f3a2b, cid-4d1e9a, test-0001).
